1	# Project Landing Page - notes
2	
3	A project's own page (`/f/<id>`), a redesign of `server/views/_folder.eta` (with
4	`_branch.eta`), whose model is built in `server/main.js` (`view()` in the
5	`/f/:id` handler). Home (prelude/landing-page) gathers what needs the person
6	across projects and links here; this page holds the project's whole picture.
7	
8	Pages: `/f/:project` (Project), `/f/:project/designs/new` (New design, modal),
9	`/f/:project/branches/:branch/publish` (Push a branch, modal),
10	`/f/:project/cleanup` (Clean up, modal), `/f/:project/branches/:branch/discard`
11	(Discard a branch, modal). Fragments:
12	`/f/:project/work`, `/f/:project/app`. States: typical (spark-lending), new
13	project, app being built, update clashed (with the app on the shell's branch
14	and a failed push), long names (an existing app to connect, no remote),
15	large project (a hundred features).
16

text:
**Not from the project page.** The app can still create an architecture, but nothing on the project page leads to where you do it.

**How creating one works now:**
- The Architecture page, `/f/<id>/architecture`, shows "Draft it from the code…" when nothing has been written yet (`server/views/architecture/overview.eta:26-37`). That button opens New design with `?kind=architecture`.
- With that kind, New design creates the architecture design and doesn't ask about a stack (`server/views/projects/_new-design.eta:13-24`, `server/main.js:738-739`).

**Why you can't get there from the project page:**
- The only link to `/f/<id>/architecture` is in the new Reference card (`server/views/projects/_reference.eta:26-36`). Per the decision recorded as R-x4b, a row only shows once it has something in it. The architecture row needs parts, so a project without an architecture never shows it. If the design system has no components either, the whole card is hidden.
- New design from the project page never offers the architecture kind. Its Kind choices are only design, design system and shell (`_new-design.eta:25-35`). The architecture kind only comes from `?kind=architecture`.
- The Designs list only shows an architecture design that already exists.

So the only way in today is to type `/f/<id>/architecture` into the address bar yourself. The Architecture design left this link to the Project Landing Page design (`prelude/architecture/NOTES.md:111`, "the person will design it in 'Project Landing Page'"). The Reference redesign covered reading an architecture, but not creating the first one.

**What I'd change** (in Project Landing Page, then built):
- `_reference.eta`: when `p.architecture` is null, show an Architecture row like "Not written yet · Draft it from the code…" linking to `/f/<id>/architecture`. That also means showing the card when this row is its only one. This loosens R-x4b, so update that rule in `prelude/project-landing-page/RULES.md` and add a note to its NOTES.md.
- Optionally, `_new-design.eta`: add an "The project's architecture" choice to Kind while `!p.architecture`, matching how system and shell are offered.
- Add a state with no architecture (and no design system) so the new row is shown and checked.
Fixing this on prelude/fix-after-the-most-recent-change-should-i-be-able-to-c, made from main. The agent can change the project there now; each turn is committed to the branch.
